warning: Amber: South Fork and Horns Bluff refuges (Saturdays and Sundays only, hunting ends at 3 p.m.). TWRA’s statewide rules list no waterfowl closures; WMAs and refuges set their own days, draws and blinds (the Public land layer marks refuges). Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: TWRA 2026–27 Hunting & Trapping Guide; TWRA South Fork and Horns Bluff refuge pages.
